name: Northern Lights
description: Two curtains of rayed light hang across a night sky in green, teal and violet, brightest along their swaying lower hems and fading upward among faint stars.

code.style: --rule: ( --h1: @r(2.2, 3.6); --h2: @r(1.4, 2.4); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: radial-gradient(circle at @r(6, 94)% @r(6, 94)%, var(--color1) 0 1.6%, transparent 2.4%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1%; width: 102%; height: calc(@var(--h1) * 100%); top: calc((@calc(((@Y * (0.5 + 0.16 * sin(6.283 * 1.1 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 0.7))) - @y + 1)) - @var(--h1)) * 100%); transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform: skewY(@calc(atan((@Y * 0.16 * 6.283 * 1.1 * cos(6.283 * 1.1 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 0.7) / @X)) * 180 / PI)deg); background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); opacity: @calc((((@Y * (0.5 + 0.16 * sin(6.283 * 1.1 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 0.7))) >= @y - 1) * ((@Y * (0.5 + 0.16 * sin(6.283 * 1.1 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 0.7))) < @y)) * @r(0.55, 1)); mask: linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0, #000 6%, #00000080 40%, transparent 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @r(3, 8)%, #00000047 0 @r(9, 15)%); mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1%; width: 102%; height: calc(@var(--h2) * 100%); top: calc((@calc(((@Y * (0.8 + 0.08 * sin(6.283 * 1.7 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 2.5))) - @y + 1)) - @var(--h2)) * 100%); transform-origin: 50% 100%; transform: skewY(@calc(atan((@Y * 0.08 * 6.283 * 1.7 * cos(6.283 * 1.7 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 2.5) / @X)) * 180 / PI)deg); background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color5)); opacity: @calc((((@Y * (0.8 + 0.08 * sin(6.283 * 1.7 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 2.5))) >= @y - 1) * ((@Y * (0.8 + 0.08 * sin(6.283 * 1.7 * ((@x - 0.5) / @X) + 2.5))) < @y)) * @r(0.55, 1)); mask: linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0, #000 6%, #00000080 40%, transparent 100%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 @r(3, 8)%, #00000047 0 @r(9, 15)%); mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
